424:       // Since we have a single segment, ordinalMap should be null:
425:       assert ordinalMap == null;

427:       LeafReaderContext context = leaves.get(0);

433:       }
434:     } else {
435:       // Since we have more than one segment, we should have a non-null ordinalMap and docValues

443:       for (int i = 0; i < numLeaves; i++) {

499:           totalDocCount++;
500:         }
501:       } else {
502:         for (int doc = it.nextDoc(); doc != DocIdSetIterator.NO_MORE_DOCS; doc = it.nextDoc()) {

504:           for (int i = 0; i < multiValues.docValueCount(); i++) {
505:             int term = (int) multiValues.nextOrd();

513:       }

527:           }
528:         } else {

530:             boolean countedDocInTotal = false;

536:                 countedDocInTotal = true;
537:               }
538:             }
539:           }
540:         }

542:         // First count in seg-ord space.
543:         // At this point, we're either counting all ordinals or our heuristic suggests that
544:         // we expect to visit a large percentage of the unique ordinals (lots of hits relative
545:         // to the segment cardinality), so we count the segment densely:
546:         final int[] segCounts = new int[segmentCardinality];
547:         if (singleValues != null) {
548:           for (int doc = it.nextDoc(); doc != DocIdSetIterator.NO_MORE_DOCS; doc = it.nextDoc()) {

551:           }
552:         } else {
553:           for (int doc = it.nextDoc(); doc != DocIdSetIterator.NO_MORE_DOCS; doc = it.nextDoc()) {

555:             for (int i = 0; i < multiValues.docValueCount(); i++) {

561:               }

563:           }

571:           }
572:         }
573:       }
574:     }
